description: New request in three steps (For with Source from, Equipment, Review) on the Future page pattern: v = fxRequests.form(state, form), set by loadChain on vbEnter and on every fxRefresh, and by formChain on every change of the form (it only reads the store); Submit runs createRequest through actChain, which opens the new request's tab; the units offered export through exportChain (docs/redesign/BUILDING-FUTURE-SCREENS.md).

v.description: fxRequests.form(state, form): the steps, the BUs, the sourcing BUs of Source from (Any first, then own fleet and the providers the IC matrix allows) and the route (requested by → sourced from), the options (projects or customers), the dates, the classes, the sourcing cards grouped by owner, the lines added, what will happen per owner, the estimate.

form.description: What the person chose so far: step, bu, source (the sourcing BU of Source from, '' for any company in the group), forKey (P:<project> or C:<customer>), task, from, to, site, note, cls, lines [{ unitId, cls }].

sent.description: The request just raised ({ id, number, bu }), for the banner.

failure.description: The engine's words when Submit did not go through (stays on the page).

fxRefresh.description: From the page module (fxPage.watch): the store changed, so loadChain runs again.
